description: Free on testnet. Status of one Ledger row (protocol, platform, wallet or stablecoin) from the human-verified Ledger: headline, status, last verified date and ONE source URL. If the name is not in the Ledger: result="unknown" plus up to 3 did_you_mean names (never a guessed answer). Call list_protocols to see every name.

protocol.description: Ledger name or short name, e.g. 'x402', 'MPP', 'Stripe Link', 'Agent Pay'. Covers protocols, platforms, wallets and stablecoins. Call list_protocols for every name.
